params.body:
The description under *Monturen* on an article said the frame page would show the article in return. That is not going to be built: linked frames appear as cards at the bottom of the article (and as `about` in the article's structured data), and the frame and collection pages stay as they are. The description now says only what happens.

One string; no schema change. Not built or tested locally: the change is the text of a description.
params.title: Say what linking a frame does: cards under the article
